app.tagline: Run or ride. Earn while you move.
app.safety: No penalty for declining. No rush timers while you move.

account.title: Your Stride & Earn account
account.name: Full name
account.partnerTitle: Earn while you run or ride
account.partnerBody: Become a Trackfud partner and get paid for deliveries that fit your workout. Complete the partner form and fitness test — our team reviews every application.
account.partnerPending: Application under review — we will notify you once the team decides.
account.submitted: Already submitted by {{name}} on {{date}} — waiting for approval.
account.updated: Status update: {{s}}. The review team also emailed you.
account.pendingLocked: The fitness test and application are locked until the review team approves or rejects this submission.
account.partnerApproved: You are a Trackfud partner. Deliveries and earnings are unlocked.
account.partnerRejected: Your last application was not approved. Review the reason below and apply again when ready.
account.frozen: Your courier account is temporarily frozen — you cannot go online or receive offers. Contact the review team to appeal.
account.banned: Your courier account is permanently closed. You cannot go online or receive offers.
account.sanctionWallet: Money you already earned stays withdrawable.
account.sanctionedRun: Your courier account status changed — new offers are paused. Money you earned stays withdrawable.
account.startTracking: Start tracking a run or ride
account.deliveryLocked: Deliveries unlock after your partner application is approved. Tracking stays free for everyone.

run.trackAiSoon: Plan two workout-first loops past busy kitchens, then Go online — the pick drives dispatch.
run.currencyConverts: {{from}} is not settled by Paddle, so payouts convert to {{to}} at {{rate}} (live rate, refreshed daily).
run.noSession: No active session — start one first.
run.stale: GPS stale — no offers until tracking resumes. Keep the screen on.
run.gpsWaiting: Waiting for GPS lock — offers start when your position is found. Go outside or enable location.
run.gpsDenied: Location blocked — enable location for this site in your browser settings, then reload.
run.gpsWeak: GPS signal too weak — your position isn't going through. Step outside under open sky.
run.gpsUnavailable: This device isn't sharing any position — a desktop without GPS never locks, so no offers can reach you. Testing on desktop? In Chrome open DevTools → More tools → Sensors and set a Location near the merchant. Real runs need a phone outdoors.
run.readyLive: You're visible to dispatch — nearby orders appear here as offers.
run.readyNoGps: Not visible to dispatch yet — waiting for a GPS lock.
run.readyLocked: Tracking works, but offers go to approved partners — finish onboarding to unlock deliveries.
run.gaps: {{count}} GPS gap(s) marked — shown honestly, never filled in.
run.liveRouteSub: Planned track in amber/white, your GPS trail in green.
run.trackMissing: That saved track is gone — pick another next time.
run.noGeoTrack: This track was drawn before map anchoring — open Tracks to re-save it on the map.
run.noPenalty: Declining is always okay — your workout comes first.
run.demoOffer: Practice offer — shown only while offline.
run.taken: Someone else took that order — keep running.
run.notice_hydration: Time for a sip of water.
run.notice_stale: Tracking paused — offers resume when GPS returns.
run.notice_gap: A GPS gap over 60 s was marked on this session.
run.sessionOffline: Server unreachable — tracking on this device only. Syncs when you reconnect.

delivery.headNow: Head to {{name}} now — food is nearly ready.
delivery.betaWarn: Walking/cycling routes are in beta and may miss sidewalks or bike paths.
delivery.stepPickup: Step 1 of 2 · pickup at the restaurant
delivery.pickupWho: Merchant code — ask staff to show their screen. Never ask the customer for this.
delivery.stepDropoff: Step 2 of 2 · handover to the customer
delivery.pinWho: Customer PIN — ask the customer to tell you face to face. Never ask the merchant for this.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every delivery you carried — delivered and cancelled, newest first.
orders.liveBody: A handover is in progress — pickup codes and PINs live here.
orders.searchHint: Matches the order code or restaurant name.
orders.errorLoad: Could not load your orders. Check your connection and try again.
orders.empty: No orders yet — accept an offer and your history lands here.
orders.emptySearch: Nothing matches — try another code, name or filter.
orders.detailMissingBody: This delivery is not on your account — it may belong to another courier.
orders.errorDetail: Could not load this order. Check your connection and try again.
orders.paidOut: Settled to your wallet on delivery.
orders.pendingPayout: Settles to your wallet on delivery.

wallet.title: Earnings
wallet.mock: Mock payouts in demo — withdraw anytime.
wallet.restDay: 6 days moving — take a rest day. Recovery is training too.
wallet.dailyCap: Daily 3 h active cap reached — call it a day.
wallet.empty: No earnings yet — go for a run.
wallet.offline: Offline — recorded on this device only.
wallet.gpxEmpty: No GPS points saved for the last session yet.
wallet.gpxSaved: GPX downloaded — import it into Strava.

coach.title: Coach this week
coach.empty: Finish a session to get your coach report.

onboard.title: Become a Partner
onboard.saveDraft: Draft auto-saves on this device and to your account when logged in.
onboard.profileHint: These details go to your partner profile for the review team.

check.title: Pre-run checklist
check.install: iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open from home screen.

fitness.title: Fitness test
fitness.purpose: Prove you can cover the partner distance on foot or pedal bike. Record a live GPS track — the server checks distance, moving time and gaps.
fitness.checkpoint: Checkpoint photo at halfway — pick any photo to prove you were out there.
fitness.recordingLock: Recording… submit unlocks after you stop.
fitness.locked: Already submitted on {{date}} — waiting for approval. Recording and submitting unlock after the review team approves or rejects your application.
fitness.approved: Fitness test passed and account approved — no need to retake it. Head out for a run when ready.

status.title: Account
status.none: No partner application yet — tracking is free. Apply when you want to earn.

voice.typePlaceholder: Or type a command: accept, how far, 2 min away
voice.server: Server voice connected — spoken offers + confirmations live.
voice.denied: Mic unavailable — type the command instead.
voice.etaHeadNow: Head to {{name}} now — food is nearly ready.

staff.title: Staff mode
staff.intro: Invited by your restaurant? Pick it below — no fitness test, fallback deliveries only.
staff.name: Your name
staff.noTest: Staff mode: no fitness test needed — fallback deliveries only.
staff.fallbackOnly: Fallback offers only — runners and bikers always get first pick.
staff.onDutyShort: Staff mode on — fallback deliveries only, no fitness test.
staff.noInviteBody: Ask your restaurant to invite this email in the Merchant app (Staff page). Then come back here and clock on shift.
staff.joinHint: Sign in with the same email the restaurant invited. Invites are by email — there is no code.
staff.notAllowed: This account is not on that restaurant's staff roster.
staff.needDeliver: That roster entry cannot deliver yet — ask the owner to enable “Can deliver”.

tracks.title: Saved tracks
tracks.intro: Draw a loop with your finger, anchor it on the map, snap it to real roads, save it, pick it at session start.
tracks.name: Track name
tracks.tooShort: Draw a loop and give it a name first.
tracks.empty: No saved tracks yet — draw one above.
tracks.mapIntro: Anchor your sketch on Google Maps — a circle becomes a real round-trip loop from and to your start point.
tracks.locationFailed: Could not get your location — check GPS permission and try again.
tracks.snappedOk: Snapped to roads ✓ — white line is the followable route.
tracks.snapFailed: No road route found — the amber sketch line still saves and opens in Maps.
tracks.needCenter: Set your location above to see the sketch on the map.

health.unavailable: Needs a phone with motion sensors — tap to enable.

chat.title: Chat
chat.offline: Live thread per delivery — tap Translate on a message for the server translation.
chat.noDeliveryBody: Chat opens with the customer as soon as a delivery is assigned to you. Start a session to get offers.
chat.errorLoad: Could not load messages. Check your connection and try again.
chat.empty: No messages yet — say hi with a quick reply.

ratings.title: My ratings
ratings.private: Customer names are always hidden — tags only.
ratings.demo: Sample summary until live ratings ship
ratings.errorLoad: Could not load your ratings. Check your connection and try again.
ratings.none: No rated deliveries yet — your stars land here.

planner.title: AI Run Planner
planner.intro: Workout first: pick a distance, start where you are, and get two easy loops past busy kitchens. Estimates are chances, never promises.
planner.needStart: Set your start point with GPS first — plans are built around you.
planner.locationFailed: Could not get your location — check GPS permission and try again.
planner.mapPreview: Two AI loop options with busy kitchens
planner.corridor: Dispatch watches {{m}} m around this loop
planner.inlineSub: Two workout-first loops past busy kitchens. The pick becomes the dispatch corridor.
planner.pickedInline: Picked: {{name}} — Go online to run it.
planner.noPlanInline: No AI plan on this session — plan one next time.
planner.liveSub: Your AI loop in amber; your GPS trail in green.
